title: Count Non Decreasing Arrays With Given Digit Sums
summary: Given an integer array digitSum of length n, find the number of distinct non-decreasing arrays arr of length n where each arr[i] is between 0 and 5000, and the sum of the digits of arr[i] equals digitSum[i].
statement: Given an integer array digitSum of length n, find the number of distinct non-decreasing arrays arr of length n where each arr[i] is between 0 and 5000, and the sum of the digits of arr[i] equals digitSum[i]. Return the count modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: digitSum is nonempty and each value is between 0 and 45.
Choose arr[i] in [0,5000] with decimal digit sum digitSum[i].
reference_solution:
def count_nondecreasing_digit_sum_arrays(digit_sum):
    modulus=1_000_000_007
    groups=[[] for _ in range(46)]
    for value in range(5001):groups[sum(map(int,str(value)))].append(value)
    previous=[0]*5001
    for value in groups[digit_sum[0]]:previous[value]=1
    for required in digit_sum[1:]:
        prefix=[0]*5001;running=0
        for value in range(5001):
            running=(running+previous[value])%modulus;prefix[value]=running
        current=[0]*5001
        for value in groups[required]:current[value]=prefix[value]
        previous=current
    return sum(previous)%modulus
